summary: 整理分类只处理左侧目录显示的范围（项目标签只审阅该项目的论文和实际显示的类别，共用类别及其上级只接收论文），未分类论文排最前且整理完不留未分类（本地兜底：先保留原类别，否则顶层“其他”并标明），预览拆成按“归类→调整→重新归类”排序、逐项可勾选的单元并由服务端保证任何勾选都能应用。

budget_impact.rationale: category_review 的单批合同不变（输入 8000 保守预检 / 输出 2000，每批一次、无重试、无推理或模型替代、显式触发），未提高任何额度、未新增外发字段（只多匿名 "lock":1，不含私有 ID/画像/笔记/反馈）。提示词变长 269 字节（2683→2952），靠压缩措辞保住 60 类×12 篇空文本极限用例（7629→7900，上限 8000）；常见规模下每批少放 0–1 篇（如 20 类 9→8、60 类 2→1），类名很长的目录上限 56→53 类，即最坏情形调用批数增加；项目标签下目录更小，通常缓解。本单元未调用任何真实模型，开发用量 0。日常核心 0 模型 token 不变。
budget_impact.before: 9fdae25；category_review 单批 8000 input/2000 output，SYSTEM 2683 字节，60 类×12 篇空文本极限 7629 字节
budget_impact.after: 同一单批合同；SYSTEM 2952 字节（+269），极限 7900 字节；每批容量如 20 类 9→8 篇、60 类 2→1 篇（可复现测量，见检查证据）；不是账单或 tokenizer 实测
budget_impact.developer_usage: Real paid development/provider requests 0 this unit. Coding-agent consumption unknown.

quantified.period: one optional category-review batch (ceiling arithmetic, unchanged; no actual usage)

reviews.reviewer: superpowers:code-reviewer subagent, read-only, round 1 (7 major + 9 minor)
same reviewer, round 2 (all fixed, but 2 new major introduced by the fixes: B1 probing cost, B2 misfiling)
same reviewer, round 3 (B1/B2/A1 fixed; 2 new major from the speed-ups: R1 classify unit could fail at apply, R2 over-bundling)
same reviewer, round 4 final targeted check: verdict yes, 3 small items (F1-F3)

open_risks: The three small items the final review left (repair keeps unrelated proposals, a cap on pair probes, neutral also_applied wording) were changed AFTER that review and are verified by the author tests only, each written to fail first.

prompts/category-review.md wording changed while status stays owner_approved with the 2026-10-07 approval sentence: caps, trigger and privacy scope are unchanged, but the owner should acknowledge the new wording; no approval field was changed by an agent.

No real model call: real answer quality (how often "其他" is used, near-synonym new categories created independently by different batches, structure decisions frozen from the first batch) is unmeasured.

Desktop build not made (main checkout and official .app are in use by another agent); merge then rebuild in the main checkout. The change set touches harness/tasks.json and docs/HANDOFF.md which also have uncommitted edits in the main checkout.
Extreme directories are tighter: 12-character names now fit 53 categories (was 56); about 11 more bytes per read-only category on the wire.

Plan is single-use: unticked units need a new (paid) review, also after an undo (undo clears the temporary preview). Moves implied by a dropped read-only merge/delete stay visible and untickable. A few higher-order combinations are completed at apply time with the fewest more label changes and the result says which (also_applied).
Sticky-footer error placement was verified in a real browser, the Node tests only assert the DOM move.
